method: Independent Python standard-library CSV recomputation, without importing the runner.
control_command_check: ramp starts at 0.3 s, reaches target at 0.6 s; pre-transition command reconstructed
interpretation: Artifact and metric consistency audit; passing checks does not establish improvement over the baseline.
exposure_reconstruction: Partition each worker's 16384 control steps by logged episode first-step timestamps; recompute stage, terrain, stage-by-terrain, ramp slope, started and completed episode counts. All nine streams match their metadata. The final partial episodes contribute their actual steps.
action_statistics_definition: Fractions count control steps, not independent samples. Vertical upper boundary means normalized action >= 1 - 1e-7 (20 N at action=1); longitudinal boundary uses absolute action. This is policy action clipping, distinct from joint torque saturation; no causal attribution is made.
training_update_definition: 65536 transitions / (4 workers * 128 steps) = 128 PPO rollouts; 4 epochs per rollout = 512 epochs, not 512 independent rollouts.
training_terrain_coverage_interpretation: Flat-only intentionally sees no ramps. Every mixed and curriculum seed recorded nonzero control-step exposure to each of -4, -2, +2 and +4 degrees.
